voice.engineSubtitle: Multi-engine architecture with automatic browser fallback
voice.browserSupported: Supported on Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Safari.
voice.browserFallbackNeeded: Firefox and other browsers do not embed Google Speech services natively.
voice.howItWorksNative: On Chrome, Edge, and Safari, speech is transcribed in real-time using the native Google / Apple Web Speech Framework with 0MB download overhead.
voice.howItWorksClient: On Firefox, Brave, and other browsers, LemonDBD automatically downloads a lightweight client-side speech model (~39MB) into browser memory. Audio is processed 100% locally on your device with complete privacy.
voice.whyNeededTitle: Why is a Client-Side Fallback Needed?
voice.whyNeededText: Mozilla Firefox, Brave, and other privacy-focused browsers do not include Google's proprietary Web Speech API server connector. The client-side fallback downloads an AI speech model in the background so you can navigate maps with voice on any browser!
voice.modelCached: Model is stored in local CacheStorage for instant zero-lag loads.
voice.privacyNotice: Privacy Note: Local client-side model processes all voice commands entirely offline inside your browser.
voice.micBlocked: Microphone blocked. Please grant mic permissions.

eldritchDevotee.title: The Eldritch Devotee
eldritchDevotee.subtitle: Incomprehensible horrors and ancient beings are your true love language.
eldritchDevotee.desc: Why settle for mortal romance when the cosmic void is calling? You embrace tentacles, teeth, and cosmic mystery.

redStainAddict.title: The Red Stain Addict
redStainAddict.subtitle: Danger is your turn-on, and terror radiuses make your heart flutter.
redStainAddict.desc: Mori animations are just aggressive cuddles in your book. You are drawn to power, menace, and dark charisma.

campfireSoulmate.title: The Campfire Soulmate
campfireSoulmate.subtitle: Wholesome teamwork and altruistic healing melt your heart.
campfireSoulmate.desc: You seek companionship, genuine smiles, and someone who will unhook you before opening the exit gate.

entitysParamour.title: The Entity’s Paramour
entitysParamour.subtitle: You see beauty, charm, and romance in almost every single soul in the Fog.
entitysParamour.desc: High standards? Never heard of them. Your heart is an endless sanctuary for all survivors and killers alike.

coldHeartedPragmatist.title: The Cold-Hearted Pragmatist
coldHeartedPragmatist.subtitle: Extremely selective, immune to charms, focused solely on survival.
coldHeartedPragmatist.desc: Very few can pass your stringent dating checklist. You need perfection, flawless perks, and zero red flags.

fogRomantic.title: The Fog Romantic
fogRomantic.subtitle: A balanced soul seeking passion and adrenaline across the trials.
fogRomantic.desc: You believe that even within the infinite trials of the Entity, a true spark of romance can always be found.
